text: S703 ran the one predeclared CLO DXF-ASTM apparel-mode pilot on the exact S700 Polo M fixture. It retains nine named pieces, but the saved return definitively fails the unchanged 0.001 cm geometry gate on the back, both stands, both collar leaves, and all three checked buttonhole marks. Numeric layer names replace semantic layers and neither file has an explicit units header. The one-sided report proves those failures but does not prove passes for below-threshold contours. The returned-render gate was not reached after the stop condition. No code, acceptance or threshold changed; do not repeat CLO modes/settings/encodings or start another CAD app for these failures.
